---
applyTo: "src/api/**"
description: "Generated openapi-fetch client: schema.d.ts comes from the backend openapi/harbor-api.yaml (npm run generate:api); session header middleware lives in client.ts."
---
# API client (`src/api/**`)

- `src/api/generated/schema.d.ts` is generated by `npm run generate:api` (openapi-typescript) from the backend
  `core/src/main/resources/openapi/harbor-api.yaml` (published copy: `harbor-docs/generated/openapi/backend.yaml`). Never edit it; never import from it
  outside `src/api` and `<feature>.types.ts`.
- A missing path or field means the backend contract has to change first; do not patch the types locally.
- `src/api/client.ts` creates the single `api = createClient<paths>({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' })` and registers the middleware that adds
  `X-Harbor-Session` from `src/api/sessionStore.ts` to every request whose path starts with `/session/`. No other place sets this header.
- `sessionStore.ts` is the only owner of the current `sessionId`; it is set when a session is created or selected and cleared on close.
- Error handling: `api.*` returns `{ data, error, response }`; hooks surface `error` to react-query, components never inspect `response`.
- Keep this folder free of feature logic; no business constants, no formatting.
